hooks.command: d="${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}"; b=node_modules/.bin/repo; [ -e "$d/$b" ] || [ -e "$d/$b.exe" ] || d="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "$d")"; m="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)"; m="${m%/*}"; r=; for c in "$d" "$m"; do for e in "" .exe; do [ -n "$c" ] && [ -e "$c/$b$e" ] && { r="$c/$b$e"; break 2; }; done; done; [ -x "$r" ] || { echo "repo: $d/$b is missing; run bun install" >&2; exit 1; }; "$r" hook orchestrate-parent
